text:
## Training & Awareness  
**Mandatory Annual Training:**
- All staff: 1-hour fraud awareness training
- Financial Crime staff: Quarterly specialist training
- Customer Service: 2 hours fraud investigation and customer communication
- Management: Fraud governance and escalation

raw_entities.name: Fraud Awareness and Training Policy
raw_entities.description: A mandatory training policy requiring all staff to complete fraud awareness training on an annual or quarterly basis, with role-specific content tailored to Financial Crime staff, Customer Service, and Management. The policy establishes minimum training hours and frequency requirements across the organisation.
context: Financial Crime staff: Quarterly specialist training
Customer Service: 2 hours fraud investigation and customer communication

raw_entities.name: Mandatory Annual Fraud Awareness Training for All Staff
raw_entities.description: All staff members are required to complete a minimum of 1 hour of fraud awareness training on an annual basis. This provision establishes the baseline training obligation across the entire organisation.

raw_entities.name: Quarterly Specialist Fraud Training for Financial Crime Staff
raw_entities.description: Financial Crime staff are required to complete specialist fraud training on a quarterly basis, reflecting their elevated role and responsibility in detecting and preventing financial crime.
context: Financial Crime staff: Quarterly specialist training

raw_entities.name: Fraud Investigation and Customer Communication Training for Customer Service Staff
raw_entities.description: Customer Service staff must complete a minimum of 2 hours of training covering fraud investigation procedures and customer communication protocols. This training equips frontline staff to identify fraud indicators and communicate appropriately with customers.
context: Customer Service: 2 hours fraud investigation and customer communication

raw_entities.name: Fraud Governance and Escalation Training for Management
raw_entities.description: Management personnel are required to receive training on fraud governance frameworks and escalation procedures, ensuring supervisory staff understand their accountability and decision-making authority in fraud response.

raw_entities.name: Fraud
raw_entities.description: Fraud is identified as a key risk category addressed by the training policy. The policy establishes mandatory awareness and specialist training requirements to mitigate fraud risk across all staff levels and functions.
context: Financial Crime staff: Quarterly specialist training

raw_entities.name: Staff Training Program
raw_entities.description: A structured training control mechanism requiring mandatory fraud awareness and specialist training across all staff roles. The control is differentiated by role and frequency to ensure appropriate knowledge levels for fraud detection and prevention.
context: Financial Crime staff: Quarterly specialist training
Customer Service: 2 hours fraud investigation and customer communication

raw_entities.name: All Staff
raw_entities.description: All staff members across the organisation are assigned the responsibility to complete mandatory annual fraud awareness training of 1 hour minimum. This establishes a baseline compliance obligation for every employee.

raw_entities.name: Financial Crime Staff
raw_entities.description: Financial Crime staff hold elevated responsibility for fraud prevention and detection, requiring them to complete quarterly specialist training to maintain expertise in identifying and responding to financial crime.
context: Financial Crime staff: Quarterly specialist training

raw_entities.name: Customer Service Staff
raw_entities.description: Customer Service staff are responsible for completing 2 hours of training on fraud investigation and customer communication, enabling them to identify fraud indicators and communicate effectively with customers regarding fraud concerns.
context: Customer Service: 2 hours fraud investigation and customer communication

raw_entities.name: Management
raw_entities.description: Management personnel are responsible for understanding fraud governance frameworks and escalation procedures, ensuring they can appropriately oversee fraud response and make informed decisions on fraud-related matters.
